15. (Currently Amended) A method of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, wherein the information is __dynamically generated based on real-time server load metrics and availability status__; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, __wherein the selection is performed by a media request broker that evaluates the information prior to routing the client request__.

16.
